newsitem.title: USA: McDonnell sees no major impact from strike.
newsitem.headline: McDonnell sees no major impact from strike.

text.p: McDonnell Douglas Corp said on Thursday that a 99-day strike at its St. Louis plant, which ended in mid-September, is not expected to have a significant adverse impact on financial results.
"Delayed deliveries caused by the strike are expected to be largely recovered during 1997," the company said.
The aerospace manufacturer, reporting higher third quarter earnings, said its financial results were led by the military aircraft segment, where operating margins exceeded 13 percent.
Shares in the St. Louis-based firm were up 1/8 to 53-7/8.
"The third quarter results continue to build on what has been a great year for McDonnell Douglas," said Chief Executive Harry Stonecipher.
"Lower revenue in the commercial aircraft segment was only partially offset by increased nine month revenues in the missiles, space and electronic systems segment," McDonnell-Douglas said.

Revenues for the military aircraft segment were $1.9 billion for the third quarter, down from $2.1 billion a year ago. Operating earnings in the segment were $253 million, compared with $237 million a year ago.

Revenues for the missiles, space and electronic systems segment were $533 million for the third quarter, compared with $488 million a year ago. Operating earnings were $43 million, down from $52 million a year ago.

Revenues for the commercial aircraft segment were $773 million for the third quarter, compared with $663 million a year ago. Operating earnings were $23 million, compared with a loss of $7 million a year ago.
As of September 30, the company had firm orders for 20 MD-80 twin jets, 121 MD-90 twin jets, 50 MD-95 twin jets and 17 MD-11 trijets.
Operating earnings in the financial services and other segment were $20 million for the third quarter, compared with $13 million a year ago. Revenues rose $18 million, to $99 million.
Pension income totalled $33 million in the third quarter, compared with $38 million a year ago.
